verdict.rationale: Composio documents runtime discovery built into the platform. Sessions give agents meta tools that discover tools. By default an agent can search the whole toolkit catalog through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS. A probe also confirms a published OpenAPI spec and an llms.txt describing tool discovery across 1,500+ toolkits. missing for 10: explicit documentation of REST catalog-listing endpoints for toolkits and tools, programmatic discovery or listing of MCP servers, and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog querying.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can query the platform's registry or catalog through a documented API to discover servers and tools programmatically

citations.quote: By default, a session has access to every toolkit in the Composio catalog. Your agent can discover and use any of them through COMPOSIO_SEARCH_TOOLS.
A session gives your agent meta tools, a small fixed set that discover, authenticate, and execute tools at runtime
Composio exposes **7 meta-tools** that let the agent discover what's available, authorize apps on demand, and execute tools across apps in parallel.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://docs.composio.dev/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
